summary: Third-pass re-verification of Escape-key closing the field-report modal in WhereItGoes section. Test PASSED against the live bundle at https://titli-landing.preview.emergentagent.com (1920x1000, networkidle load). Clicking [data-testid='story-slide-1'] opens [data-testid='location-modal'] (visible=True). Pressing Escape closes it — modal count becomes 0 and is_visible is False. The Escape handler at WhereItGoes.jsx lines 127-133 works as intended. Previous iteration_3 failure was almost certainly a stale bundle/caching artifact in the prior test browser context.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Escape-to-close for [data-testid='location-modal'] confirmed working in-browser. Only story-slide-1 was exercised; if paranoid, repeat for slide-0/slide-2. Test used a fresh Playwright context (clear_cookies) to avoid the stale-bundle issue that likely tripped iteration_3.
rca of the issue: iteration_3 reported the Escape handler as missing. Root cause: stale JS bundle cached in the prior test browser context — the handler exists in source (WhereItGoes.jsx L127-133: useEffect on modalItem attaching a keydown listener that calls setModalItem(null) on 'Escape'). Re-running with a fresh Playwright context + networkidle load reproduced the correct behavior (modal closes on Escape). Mitigation: future testing agents should start with a fresh browser context or explicitly bypass cache when validating recently-deployed handlers.
